jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - Commercial & Consumer Law - Limburg
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international leisure and hospitality group headquartered in Europe, operating multiple business units across several countries. The Belgian organization employs approximately 2,000 people across different sites and operates within a highly decentralized structure, allowing local entities to maintain significant autonomy while benefiting from the support of a large international group.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Counsel your responsibilities are:

• Provide pragmatic and business-oriented legal advice to senior management and operational teams.
• Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a variety of commercial contracts.
• Advise on agency, distribution, procurement, and service agreements.
• Support construction and real estate projects, including related contractual negotiations.
• Monitor and advise on consumer law matters impacting the Belgian business.
• Contribute to ESG-related projects and provide legal support regarding evolving sustainability regulations.
• Identify legal risks and develop practical mitigation strategies.
• Strengthen compliance frameworks and internal governance procedures.
• Collaborate closely with departments such as Procurement, Marketing, Communications, and Operations.
• Translate complex legal concepts into pragmatic solutions that facilitate business growth.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Master's degree in Law obtained from a Belgian university.
• Minimum 3 years of relevant legal experience as legal counsel or lawyer
• Fluent in English, ideally in Dutch as well (or conversational level)
• Strong expertise in: Commercial contracts, Consumer law, Real estate and construction law
• Exposure to ESG-related matters is considered a strong asset.
• Comfortable working independently and managing a broad legal scope.

Contract Details

• Full-time position in a dynamic international environment for a period of 3 months
• Day shift schedule.
• Temporary assignment of at least one month, with the possibility of extension.
• Flexible working hours, with the option to start as early as 7:00 AM.
• Hybrid working model with the possibility to work partly from home.

Jobomschrijving

Our customer is looking for an Administrator to join the Packaging Department. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring suppliers to ensure their packaging complies with the European Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).

Your responsibilities include:

• Monitoring suppliers' compliance with PPWR requirements and ensuring project deadlines are achieved.
• Organizing and facilitating online meetings with suppliers.
• Advising suppliers on packaging types, responsibilities, and compliance expectations.
• Explaining regulatory requirements and guiding suppliers through implementation plans.
• Coordinating action plans and establishing clear timelines and milestones.
• Following up on corrective actions and tracking supplier progress.
• Preparing weekly compliance and progress reports for management.
• Escalating risks, concerns, and non-compliance issues when necessary.
• Conducting compliance checks and audits on packaging and manufacturer labels within warehouse operations.
• Verifying that packaging and labeling activities comply with PPWR regulations and internal quality standards.
• Contributing to a sustainable, compliant, and efficient supply chain environment.

Who are we looking for? 

• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field.
• Experience in logistics, compliance, supply chain administration, or project coordination is an asset.
• Knowledge of sustainable packaging solutions is considered a strong plus.
• Fluent in English.
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel, SharePoint,  Access and/or Power BI.
• Able to manage multiple suppliers, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
• Detail-oriented, accurate, and reliable.
• Capable of working independently while maintaining close collaboration with colleagues.
• Proactive mindset with strong follow-up skills, analytic, team-oriented, positive, handson.

This international company specializes in the manufacturing and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, producing high-quality injection-molded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.

Your Responsibilities

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas.

• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

Our client is a global leader in food manufacturing, known for its strong focus on innovation and operational excellence.

The Process Expert plays a key role in optimizing production processes, leading new product introductions, and improving plant performance across liquid and solid chocolate processing operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead new product introduction (NPI), process transfers, and factory trials
• Optimize production lines to improve throughput, reduce waste and losses
• Define and implement process standards, work instructions and recipes
• Collaborate with R&D, quality, engineering and operations teams
• Analyze process performance and identify continuous improvement actions
• Support and coach shopfloor teams on best practices and standards
• Manage process validation linked to chocolate liquid & solid processing
• Drive product industrialization and ensure compliance with quality standards

• Engineering degree (Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial or similar)
• First experience in FMCG / food / process industry
• Strong knowledge of chocolate or similar processing technologies: Mixing, refining, conching, tempering, depositing
• Understanding of rheology and process parameters
• Familiarity with SAP, MES or industrial automation tools
• Hands-on mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to influence, train and engage operational teams
• Fluent in English (and French/Dutch preferred)

For an international company active in the medical sector, we are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist to support the development and execution of digital marketing activities across the Benelux region.

The company develops and distributes high-quality medical products and solutions to healthcare professionals worldwide. With a strong international presence, the organization combines innovation, quality and customer focus with a commitment to employee development and collaboration.

Jobomschrijving

The roleAs a Digital Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for implementing digital marketing campaigns and supporting local marketing initiatives across the Benelux. You will work closely with the Marketing Manager to translate the marketing strategy into impactful campaigns that increase brand awareness, engage healthcare professionals and support commercial objectives.

Your responsibilities:

• Digital campaigns & content: Develop and coordinate digital campaigns across social media, newsletters, websites and external platforms, ensuring engaging and relevant content for the target audience.
• Local marketing activation: Adapt international marketing initiatives to local market needs and support the communication of promotions, events and webinars.
• Website & webshop management: Ensure that online content, product information and promotional activities are accurate and up to date.
• Performance analysis: Monitor campaign performance through relevant KPIs, report on results and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
• Operational marketing & project coordination: Support the development of promotional materials, budget tracking and supplier coordination, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and on time.

Your profile

• You have initial a first experience in digital marketing or a similar marketing role.
• You are fluent in French and English. A basic knowledge of Dutch is an asset.
• You have experience with digital campaigns and content creation. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, HubSpot or Hootsuite is a plus.
• Experience managing websites or webshops is an advantage.
• You are organized, proactive and hands-on, with the ability to manage projects independently and handle multiple priorities.
• You have strong communication skills, an analytical mindset and a willingness to learn.

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager | FMCG Non-Food | Relocation to Paris

jobs.occupation: Sales Executive Benelux - Watches Industry (Dutch Native)
jobs.description:

• Build strong partnerships with retailers and act as the main point of contact for the brands.

• Strong affinity for the watches industry

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do

• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to Know
You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:

• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Our customer is an international company active in the healthcare industry (medical devices) having its European headquarters based in Zaventem.

Jobomschrijving

As Payroll & Benefits Specialist, you are responsible for the full, accurate and timely management of the company's payroll administration for all employees, in full compliance with legal requirements and internal policies.
You play a central role in optimising payroll processes, with a strong affinity for Compensation & Benefits, and actively contribute to broader HR projects.

Key responsibilities:- Ensure the accurate execution of the monthly payroll cycle, including salary calculations, benefits, taxes and social security contributions.
- Deliver ad-hoc reporting and analytics, providing detailed insights into payroll costs, HR trends and other key performance indicators.
- Work closely with the external payroll provider (e.g. SD Worx) to guarantee a smooth and reliable payroll operation.
- Manage and continuously improve processes related to leave, absences and employee benefits (insurance plans, meal vouchers, etc.).
- Act as the primary point of contact for employees regarding payroll and benefits-related queries, with the ability to clearly explain payroll related processes.
- Actively contribute to HR projects, including initiatives aimed at improving payroll and compensation efficiency and the implementation of new HR tools or solutions.
- Ensure full compliance with social and tax legislation and promote best practices within the payroll function.

The ideal candidate can demonstrate the following skills and experience:

- You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in a relevant field or equivalent by experience

- You can demonstrate more than 4 years of experience in payroll management. Any additional experience with the UK, Germany, or the Netherlands payroll systems is considered an asset.

- You have a very good knowledge of the Belgian social legislation

- You are fluent in English and Dutch (both written and spoken), knowledge of French is an asset.

- You possess good communication skills allowing you to clearly explain HR payroll related processes to varied stakeholders

- You are customer oriented, can handle confidential information with the necessary discretion and enjoy working within an international and multicultural environment

Our client is a prestigious international law firm based in Brussels. To support its operations during a temporary period, they are currently looking for a Receptionist to join their team until the end of December.

Jobomschrijving

As a Receptionist, you will be the first point of contact for visitors and play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Proactive, flexible and reliable approach to work.
• Team player with excellent relationship-building skills.

Our client is a well-established international player in the fashion industry, renowned for its creativity, quality, and commitment to excellence. As a Personal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage administrative mailboxes and general office correspondence.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager IT
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international player operating in the retail and distribution sector, with a strong presence in multiple markets. The company provides a wide range of products and services to both professional and private customers, supported by an extensive network and a strong focus on customer experience.

As part of the IT organization, you will play a key role in analyzing, optimizing, and transforming business processes across Supply Chain and Finance domains. Acting as a strategic business partner, you will work closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and translate business needs into sustainable IT solutions.

Jobomschrijving

• Analyze end-to-end business processes, particularly within Supply Chain and Finance, and identify opportunities for optimization and efficiency gains.
• Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, define requirements, and design improved processes.
• Translate business needs into pragmatic, scalable, and sustainable SAP-based solutions.
• Challenge business requirements by proposing alternatives aligned with industry best practices and standard solutions.
• Lead or contribute to functional design activities, testing phases, implementation projects, and change initiatives.
• Coordinate collaboration between business teams, IT teams, SAP experts, and external partners to ensure successful project delivery.
• Ensure consistency and integration across SAP modules and business processes.
• Support issue resolution by providing functional expertise and a strong understanding of business impacts.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the evolution of the application landscape.
• Participate in roadmap definition and transformation programs, from analysis through implementation.
• Take ownership of projects or workstreams, ensuring effective planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery.

• 5 to 10 years of experience in a Senior Business Analyst, SAP Consultant, SAP Functional Analyst, or similar role.
• Proven experience working on SAP-related projects, with strong knowledge of Supply Chain and/or Finance processes.
• Good understanding of end-to-end business processes, ideally within a retail, distribution, or complex operational environment.
• Ability to quickly understand business challenges and translate them into effective solutions.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure complex topics and provide clear recommendations.
• Experience managing projects, coordinating stakeholders, and driving delivery is a strong asset.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with both business and technical audiences.
• Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on business value and results.
• Proactive, autonomous, and comfortable working in a dynamic and evolving environment.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is considered an advantage.
• Open-minded, collaborative, and motivated by change and continuous improvement.

Application & Service Management

Project Management & Product Ownership

• Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
• Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
• Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and service improvement.

IT Governance, Compliance & Administration

• Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.
• Contribute to IT risk and control frameworks, including regulatory requirements such as DORA, GDPR, and MiFID II.
• Ensure IT services comply with internal policies and external regulatory obligations.
• Monitor and continuously improve IT processes within the local business environment.

• Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments is considered an asset.

• Strong organizational and administrative skills with great attention to detail.

• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a strong advantage.
